action_items: Backend pytest.ini pins -n 2 --dist loadscope, but the app has a single shared demo-student singleton with no per-request isolation endpoint. Under loadscope, different test MODULES can still be scheduled to different xdist workers and race on the shared demo-student row (observed DuplicateKeyError / 409s during triage). Mitigation applied: all demo-student-touching test files carry `pytestmark = pytest.mark.xdist_group(name="demo_student")`, but loadscope ignores xdist_group (that only takes effect under --dist loadgroup). Run the suite with `-n 0` (documented as the supported serial override) for guaranteed-correct results; this is what was used to certify all 16 tests above. If CI runs the bare configured addopts (-n 2 --dist loadscope) without -n 0, occasional flakiness from cross-module demo-student races is possible and is an environment/config note, not an application bug.
